# MCP Blocks UI — Complete Documentation

> UI components for Claude MCP Apps. React components for Claude MCP Apps and interactive connectors, built on Claude's host tokens, display modes and mobile safe areas. Works in ChatGPT too.

- Website: https://mcpblocks.dev
- Registry JSON: https://mcpblocks.dev/r/registry.json
- Live demo MCP server: https://mcpblocks.dev/mcp
- GitHub: https://github.com/contursofran/mcpblocks

---

## Installation

Prerequisites: React 18+, Tailwind CSS v4 (`@theme inline`), `components.json` (`npx shadcn@latest init`), and `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps`.

Install any component (dependencies such as `host-tokens`, `host`, `host-button`, and `icons` are installed automatically):

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/<component-slug>.json
```

---

# MCP Blocks UI — Agent Integration Guide

This file helps AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity, etc.) choose, install, and wire **MCP Blocks UI** components when building **MCP Apps** (interactive UI views rendered inside Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Goose, and Vercel AI SDK hosts).

- **Homepage:** https://mcpblocks.dev
- **Full docs (single file):** https://mcpblocks.dev/llms-full.txt
- **LLM index:** https://mcpblocks.dev/llms.txt
- **Registry manifest:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/registry.json
- **Live demo MCP server:** https://mcpblocks.dev/mcp
- **Source repo:** https://github.com/contursofran/mcpblocks

## Component Selection Matrix

| User need / UI pattern | Recommended component | Install command |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Search results, Slack threads, tickets, or short list of records (4–5 rows) | `ListView` | `npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/list-view.json` |
| Compact summary card with ≤5 key/value fields and ≤2 action buttons | `InlineCard` | `npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/inline-card.json` |
| Approval / confirmation step for a write action Claude prepared | `ConfirmAction` | `npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/confirm-action.json` |
| Success, info, warning, or error result banner with optional Undo/View button | `StatusUpdate` | `npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/status-update.json` |
| Time-series / metrics trend chart (dependency-free SVG, borderless) | `LineChart` | `npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/line-chart.json` |
| Inline audio playback with seekable waveform + regenerate/download | `MediaPlayer` | `npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/media-player.json` |
| 3–8 visual comparable items (places, products, trails) with save toggle | `Carousel` | `npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/carousel.json` |
| Editable document/notes card with properties, bullet items, and checkboxes | `DocumentCard` | `npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/document-card.json` |
| Loading state while tool results arrive (use skeletons, never spinners) | `RowsSkeleton` / `InlineCardSkeleton` / `CarouselSkeleton` | `npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/skeleton.json` |

## Hard Rules for Claude MCP Apps

Follow these rules whenever generating or modifying MCP App views:

1. **Use `host-*` Tailwind utilities only** (`bg-host-bg`, `bg-host-bg-secondary`, `text-host-fg`, `text-host-fg-tertiary`, `border-host-border-secondary`, `rounded-host-md`, etc.). Never hardcode hex/rgb colors — Claude injects host CSS variables at runtime for light and dark themes.
2. **No floating UI layers:** Do not use dropdowns, popovers, context menus, native `<select>`, or Radix floating primitives. They clip at iframe boundaries and conflict with host z-index.
3. **No nested vertical scrolling or viewport height units:** Inline widgets must auto-fit their content height (stay under ~520px). Never use `overflow-y-auto`, `overflow-auto`, `h-screen`, `vh`, or `dvh`.
4. **Inline limits:** Keep inline cards to ≤5 fields and ≤2 actions at the bottom. Keep carousels to 3–8 items. Send edits back through chat via `app.sendMessage(...)` rather than building full forms inline.
5. **44×44px minimum tap targets:** Use `HostButton` (`min-h-11`) or `size-11` for interactive icon buttons.
6. **Skeletons, not spinners:** Render `RowsSkeleton`, `InlineCardSkeleton`, or `CarouselSkeleton` while waiting for tool results.
7. **Borderless views:** For `LineChart`, `Carousel`, `InlineCard`, and `StatusUpdate`, set `_meta: { ui: { prefersBorder: false } }` on the `ui://` resource so the host does not draw a double border.
8. **Sandbox constraints:** Never rely on `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `document.cookie`, or `window.openai`.

## Standard View Wiring (`@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` 2.x)

```tsx
import { useApp, useHostStyles } from "@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/react"
import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { InlineCard } from "@/components/inline-card"
import { RowsSkeleton } from "@/components/skeleton"
import { applyHostContext } from "@/lib/host"

export function View() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null)
  const { app } = useApp({
    appInfo: { name: "my-mcp-app", version: "1.0.0" },
    capabilities: {},
    onAppCreated: (app) => {
      app.ontoolresult = (result) => setData(result.structuredContent)
      app.onhostcontextchanged = (ctx) => applyHostContext(ctx)
    },
  })

  useHostStyles(app, app?.getHostContext())
  useEffect(() => {
    if (app) applyHostContext(app.getHostContext())
  }, [app])

  if (!data) return <RowsSkeleton rows={3} columns={3} />
  return <InlineCard title={data.title} fields={data.fields} actions={data.actions} />
}
```

## Server Pattern (`@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/server`)

- Register tools with `registerAppTool` pointing `_meta: { ui: { resourceUri: "ui://my-app/view.html" } }`.
- Keep mutating confirmation tools hidden from the LLM using `visibility: ["app"]` so only the UI can invoke them via `app.callServerTool(...)`.
- Always return useful text in `content` alongside `structuredContent` so text-only hosts still work.
- Bundle the React view into a single HTML file (e.g. `vite-plugin-singlefile`) and serve it via `registerAppResource` with `mimeType: RESOURCE_MIME_TYPE` (`text/html;profile=mcp-app`).

---

## Component Reference

# List view — MCP Blocks UI

> A short list of rich rows (messages, tickets, search results) with avatars, metadata and a footer link to the rest.

- **Category:** Inline cards
- **Display modes:** inline
- **Host container variant:** `card`
- **Design source:** MCP Apps for Claude kit · Inline card / List views
- **Docs URL:** https://mcpblocks.dev/components/list-view
- **Registry JSON:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/list-view.json

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/list-view.json
```

Automatically installs `host-tokens` (Claude CSS variables + Tailwind v4 `host-*` utilities) and required helpers.

## Guidelines

- 4–5 rows inline, link to the rest
- Rows clamp to two lines
- Footer link opens your app or fullscreen

## Usage

```tsx
import { ListView } from "@/components/list-view"

<ListView
  items={messages.map((m) => ({
    id: m.id,
    initials: m.author.initials,
    title: m.author.name,
    meta: m.channel,
    timestamp: m.date,
    body: m.text,
  }))}
  summary={`Showing 4 of ${total} results`}
  viewAll={{ label: "View in App", onClick: () => app.requestDisplayMode({ mode: "fullscreen" }) }}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `ListViewItem[]` | id, initials, avatarColor?, title, meta?, timestamp?, body?, onClick? |
| `summary` | `string` | Footer text, e.g. "Showing 4 of 12 results". |
| `viewAll` | `{ label, href?, onClick? }` | Footer link to the full list. |

---

# Confirm action — MCP Blocks UI

> Confirmation for a change Claude has prepared: what will happen, who it applies to, one confirm button, and what the change includes.

- **Category:** Inline cards
- **Display modes:** inline
- **Host container variant:** `card`
- **Design source:** MCP Apps for Claude kit · Inline card / Confirmation actions
- **Docs URL:** https://mcpblocks.dev/components/confirm-action
- **Registry JSON:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/confirm-action.json

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/confirm-action.json
```

Automatically installs `host-tokens` (Claude CSS variables + Tailwind v4 `host-*` utilities) and required helpers.

## Guidelines

- One confirm action; edits stay in the chat
- Working, done and error states in place
- Undo offered after success

## Usage

```tsx
import { ConfirmAction } from "@/components/confirm-action"

<ConfirmAction
  title="Set lead assignment permission"
  subject={{ name: "Sarah Johnson", detail: "sarah.johnson@company.com" }}
  confirmLabel="Confirm assignment"
  onConfirm={() => app.callServerTool({ name: "assign_permission", arguments: { userId } })}
  details={{ heading: "Lead assignment permissions", items: permissions }}
  doneTitle="Permission assigned"
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | What will happen. |
| `subject` | `{ name, detail?, initials?, avatarColor? }` | The person or record it applies to. |
| `onConfirm` | `() => unknown` | Return a promise to show the working state; a rejection shows the error state. |
| `details` | `{ heading, items[] }` | What the change includes, as a checklist. |
| `status` | `pending \| working \| done \| error` | Control the state from outside. |

---

# Media player — MCP Blocks UI

> An inline audio card with play/pause, a waveform you can click to seek, the duration and optional regenerate/download actions.

- **Category:** Data & media
- **Display modes:** inline
- **Host container variant:** `card`
- **Design source:** MCP Apps for Claude kit · Inline card / Media card
- **Docs URL:** https://mcpblocks.dev/components/media-player
- **Registry JSON:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/media-player.json

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/media-player.json
```

Automatically installs `host-tokens` (Claude CSS variables + Tailwind v4 `host-*` utilities) and required helpers.

## Guidelines

- Playback stays inline, no new window
- Waveform is keyboard-seekable (←/→)
- Two actions at most

## Usage

```tsx
import { MediaPlayer } from "@/components/media-player"

<MediaPlayer
  title="Podcast Intro"
  subtitle="Rachel · Warm"
  src={result.audioUrl}
  peaks={result.peaks}
  onRegenerate={() => app.sendMessage({ role: "user", content: [{ type: "text", text: "Try a different voice" }] })}
  onDownload={() => app.openLink({ url: result.audioUrl })}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | Audio URL. Without it the card is a static preview. |
| `peaks` | `number[]` | Waveform values 0–1. A stable placeholder is generated if omitted. |
| `duration` | `number` | Seconds, shown before metadata loads. |
| `onRegenerate / onDownload` | `() => void` | Show the matching icon buttons. |

---

# Line chart — MCP Blocks UI

> A borderless line chart with soft area fills, a hover tooltip, range tabs and a legend. Dependency-free SVG.

- **Category:** Data & media
- **Display modes:** inline, borderless
- **Host container variant:** `borderless` (set `_meta.ui.prefersBorder: false`)
- **Design source:** MCP Apps for Claude kit · Inline card / Borderless card
- **Docs URL:** https://mcpblocks.dev/components/line-chart
- **Registry JSON:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/line-chart.json

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/line-chart.json
```

Automatically installs `host-tokens` (Claude CSS variables + Tailwind v4 `host-*` utilities) and required helpers.

## Guidelines

- Borderless: set _meta.ui.prefersBorder = false
- Tooltip on hover, no popovers
- Fits inline without scrolling

## Usage

```tsx
import { LineChart } from "@/components/line-chart"

<LineChart
  title="Chats and messages"
  labels={days}
  series={[
    { name: "Messages", values: messages },
    { name: "Chats", values: chats },
  ]}
  ranges={["1D", "1W", "1M", "1Y"]}
  onRangeChange={(r) => app.callServerTool({ name: "get_usage", arguments: { range: r } })}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `labels` | `string[]` | One label per point; also shown in the tooltip. |
| `series` | `{ name, values[], color? }[]` | Up to ~4 series. |
| `ranges / range / onRangeChange` | `string[] / string / fn` | Optional range tabs. |
| `formatValue` | `(v) => string` | Axis and tooltip formatting. |

---

# Document card — MCP Blocks UI

> A page or document preview with properties, lists and tasks that the user can edit in place, then hand back to Claude.

- **Category:** Inline cards
- **Display modes:** inline
- **Host container variant:** `card`
- **Design source:** MCP Apps for Claude kit · Inline card / Inline editing
- **Docs URL:** https://mcpblocks.dev/components/document-card
- **Registry JSON:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/document-card.json

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/document-card.json
```

Automatically installs `host-tokens` (Claude CSS variables + Tailwind v4 `host-*` utilities) and required helpers.

## Guidelines

- Small edits in place, big changes in chat
- Checkboxes are real inputs
- onChange returns the full updated content

## Usage

```tsx
import { DocumentCard } from "@/components/document-card"

<DocumentCard
  icon="📋"
  title={page.title}
  properties={[{ label: "Type", value: "Meeting notes", tag: true }]}
  sections={[
    { kind: "list", heading: "Agenda", items: page.agenda },
    { kind: "tasks", heading: "Action items", items: page.tasks, placeholder: "To be filled during meeting" },
  ]}
  onChange={(sections) => app.callServerTool({ name: "update_page", arguments: { id: page.id, sections } })}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `properties` | `{ label, value, tag? }[]` | Key/value rows at the top. |
| `sections` | `DocumentSection[]` | "list" (editable text) or "tasks" (checkboxes). |
| `editable` | `boolean` | Default true. |
| `onChange` | `(sections) => void` | Fires after each edit. |

---

# Carousel — MCP Blocks UI

> A horizontal row of comparable items with tall images, a save toggle, a rating and a meta row, with a fading edge and next button.

- **Category:** Data & media
- **Display modes:** inline, borderless
- **Host container variant:** `borderless` (set `_meta.ui.prefersBorder: false`)
- **Design source:** MCP Apps for Claude kit · Inline carousel
- **Docs URL:** https://mcpblocks.dev/components/carousel
- **Registry JSON:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/carousel.json

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/carousel.json
```

Automatically installs `host-tokens` (Claude CSS variables + Tailwind v4 `host-*` utilities) and required helpers.

## Guidelines

- 3–8 items (dev warning outside that range)
- Next card peeks behind a fade
- One action per card (save)

## Usage

```tsx
import { Carousel } from "@/components/carousel"

<Carousel
  label="Nearby hikes"
  items={trails.map((t) => ({
    id: t.id,
    title: t.name,
    subtitle: t.park,
    image: t.photo,
    rating: t.rating,
    meta: [t.difficulty, t.distance],
    saved: t.saved,
    onSave: (saved) => app.callServerTool({ name: "save_trail", arguments: { id: t.id, saved } }),
  }))}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `CarouselItem[]` | id, title, subtitle?, image?, rating?, meta?, saved?, onSave?, onClick? |
| `cardWidth / imageHeight` | `number` | Default 220 × 280, as in the kit. |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name for the scroll region. |

---

# Skeleton — MCP Blocks UI

> Loading placeholders. RowsSkeleton is the kit's loading state for lists and tables; InlineCardSkeleton and CarouselSkeleton match those components.

- **Category:** Feedback
- **Display modes:** inline, fullscreen
- **Host container variant:** `card`
- **Design source:** MCP Apps for Claude kit · Inline card / Loading
- **Docs URL:** https://mcpblocks.dev/components/skeleton
- **Registry JSON:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/skeleton.json

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/skeleton.json
```

Automatically installs `host-tokens` (Claude CSS variables + Tailwind v4 `host-*` utilities) and required helpers.

## Guidelines

- Matches the final layout
- No spinners
- Announced as loading to screen readers

## Usage

```tsx
import { RowsSkeleton } from "@/components/skeleton"

{data ? <ListView items={data.items} /> : <RowsSkeleton rows={4} columns={3} />}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RowsSkeleton` | `{ rows?, columns?, avatar? }` | Avatar + columns, as in the kit. |
| `InlineCardSkeleton` | `{ fields?, actions? }` | Matches InlineCard. |
| `CarouselSkeleton` | `{ count?, cardWidth? }` | Matches Carousel. |
| `HostSkeleton` | `component` | A single pulsing block. |

---

# Inline card — MCP Blocks UI

> A compact card for the conversation: a title, up to five data points and up to two actions. Its height always fits its content.

- **Category:** Inline cards
- **Display modes:** inline
- **Host container variant:** `borderless` (set `_meta.ui.prefersBorder: false`)
- **Design source:** MCP Blocks UI
- **Docs URL:** https://mcpblocks.dev/components/inline-card
- **Registry JSON:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/inline-card.json

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/inline-card.json
```

Automatically installs `host-tokens` (Claude CSS variables + Tailwind v4 `host-*` utilities) and required helpers.

## Guidelines

- At most 5 data points (dev warning above that)
- At most 2 actions, placed at the bottom
- No inner scrolling, height fits content
- 44px tap targets

## Usage

```tsx
import { InlineCard } from "@/components/inline-card"

export function DealSummary({ deal }) {
  return (
    <InlineCard
      title={deal.name}
      badge={{ label: "At risk", tone: "warning" }}
      fields={[
        { label: "Owner", value: deal.owner },
        { label: "Stage", value: deal.stage },
      ]}
      actions={[
        { label: "Open record", onClick: () => app.requestDisplayMode({ mode: "fullscreen" }) },
        { label: "Draft follow-up", onClick: () => app.sendMessage({ role: "user", content: [{ type: "text", text: "Draft a follow-up" }] }) },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | Card heading. |
| `badge` | `{ label, tone? }` | Status chip: neutral, info, success, warning or danger. |
| `fields` | `{ label, value }[]` | Data points. Keep to 5 or fewer. |
| `actions` | `{ label, onClick?, variant? }[]` | Up to 2 buttons. First is primary. |
| `columns` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4` | Field grid columns. 4 collapses to 2 on narrow widths. |

---

# Status update — MCP Blocks UI

> Confirms what happened after an action, with the host's semantic colors and one optional follow-up.

- **Category:** Feedback
- **Display modes:** inline
- **Host container variant:** `borderless` (set `_meta.ui.prefersBorder: false`)
- **Design source:** MCP Blocks UI
- **Docs URL:** https://mcpblocks.dev/components/status-update
- **Registry JSON:** https://mcpblocks.dev/r/status-update.json

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/status-update.json
```

Automatically installs `host-tokens` (Claude CSS variables + Tailwind v4 `host-*` utilities) and required helpers.

## Guidelines

- Semantic host tokens only
- Icon has a text label
- One follow-up action at most

## Usage

```tsx
import { StatusUpdate } from "@/components/status-update"

<StatusUpdate
  tone="success"
  title="Invoice sent to Northwind"
  description="INV-2041 · delivered just now"
  action={{ label: "View", onClick: openInvoice }}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `success \| info \| warning \| danger` | Sets icon and colors. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | What happened. |
| `action` | `{ label, onClick? }` | Optional follow-up, like Undo or View. |

---

## Design Tokens (`host-tokens`)

Install tokens standalone with:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/host-tokens.json
```

### Colors

| Group | Token | CSS Variable | Tailwind Utility | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Background | primary | `--color-background-primary` | `bg-host-bg` | `#ffffff` | `#30302e` |
| Background | secondary | `--color-background-secondary` | `bg-host-bg-secondary` | `#f5f4ed` | `#262624` |
| Background | tertiary | `--color-background-tertiary` | `bg-host-bg-tertiary` | `#faf9f5` | `#141413` |
| Background | inverse | `--color-background-inverse` | `bg-host-bg-inverse` | `#141413` | `#faf9f5` |
| Background | info | `--color-background-info` | `bg-host-info-bg` | `#d6e4f6` | `#253e5f` |
| Background | danger | `--color-background-danger` | `bg-host-danger-bg` | `#b53333` | `#dd5353` |
| Background | success | `--color-background-success` | `bg-host-success-bg` | `#e9f1dc` | `#1b4614` |
| Background | warning | `--color-background-warning` | `bg-host-warning-bg` | `#f6eedf` | `#483a0f` |
| Background | ghost | `--color-background-ghost` | `bg-host-bg-ghost` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)` | `rgba(48, 48, 46, 0)` |
| Background | disabled | `--color-background-disabled` | `bg-host-bg-disabled` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)` | `rgba(48, 48, 46, 0.5)` |

| Ring | primary | `--color-ring-primary` | `ring-host-ring` | `rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.7)` | `rgba(250, 249, 245, 0.7)` |
| Ring | secondary | `--color-ring-secondary` | `ring-host-ring-secondary` | `rgba(61, 61, 58, 0.7)` | `rgba(194, 192, 182, 0.7)` |
| Ring | inverse | `--color-ring-inverse` | `ring-host-ring-inverse` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)` | `rgba(20, 20, 19, 0.7)` |
| Ring | info | `--color-ring-info` | `ring-host-ring-info` | `rgba(50, 102, 173, 0.5)` | `rgba(128, 170, 221, 0.5)` |
| Ring | danger | `--color-ring-danger` | `ring-host-ring-danger` | `rgba(167, 61, 57, 0.5)` | `rgba(205, 92, 88, 0.5)` |
| Ring | success | `--color-ring-success` | `ring-host-ring-success` | `rgba(67, 116, 38, 0.5)` | `rgba(89, 145, 48, 0.5)` |
| Ring | warning | `--color-ring-warning` | `ring-host-ring-warning` | `rgba(128, 92, 31, 0.5)` | `rgba(168, 120, 41, 0.5)` |

---

# Conformance

Tracks `mcpblocks` against Anthropic's [MCP Apps design guidelines](https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/mcp-apps/design-guidelines) and the [MCP Apps specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Last verified** | 2026-11-25 |
| **Automated checks** | `pnpm lint` + `pnpm check:conformance` + live DOM linter in `HostPreview` |

## Rules & Enforcement

| Rule | How `mcpblocks` enforces it |
| --- | --- |
| **No dropdowns, context menus, popovers or floating panels** | ESLint `no-restricted-imports` and `scripts/check-conformance.mjs` ban floating `@radix-ui/react-*` primitives and the `radix-ui` barrel in `registry/mcpblocks/`. `HostPreview` DOM linter flags `<select>` and `role="menu"` / `role="dialog"` / `role="listbox"` elements inline. |
| **Inline cards auto-fit height; no nested vertical scrolling** | ESLint and `scripts/check-conformance.mjs` ban `overflow-auto`, `overflow-y-auto`, `overflow-scroll`, and `overflow-y-scroll` in `registry/mcpblocks/`. `HostPreview` DOM linter checks rendered computed styles for vertical scroll containers (`scrollHeight > clientHeight` with `overflow-y: auto|scroll`) and flags inline widgets taller than ~520px. |
| **No viewport units for height** | ESLint and `scripts/check-conformance.mjs` ban `h-screen`, `vh`, `svh`, `lvh`, and `dvh` in `registry/mcpblocks/`. |
| **At most 2 actions and 4–5 fields in inline cards** | `InlineCard` logs dev-only `[mcpblocks]` warnings via `guideline()` when `actions.length > 2` or `fields.length > 5`, and slices actions to 2. `HostPreview` DOM linter flags >2 action buttons in inline mode. |
| **3–8 comparable items in inline carousels** | `Carousel` warns via `guideline()` outside 3–8 items and uses `scroll-padding-inline` with `--mb-safe-left` / `--mb-safe-right`. |
| **Tap targets at least 44×44px** | `HostButton` enforces `min-h-11` (44px); interactive icon buttons in `Carousel` and `MediaPlayer` use `size-11` (44×44px). Inline text links (such as the footer link in `ListView`) follow the WCAG 2.5.8 inline exception. `HostPreview` DOM linter flags interactive buttons under 44px. |
| **Host CSS tokens only (no hardcoded colors)** | Components use `host-*` Tailwind utilities backed by Claude's host variables (`--color-background-primary`, etc.) with light/dark fallbacks in `host-tokens`. `scripts/check-conformance.mjs` blocks literal hex/rgb/hsl colors in `registry/mcpblocks/` (allowlisting only `LineChart`'s categorical `PALETTE` array) and verifies `app/globals.css` matches `registry.json`. |
| **Icons use `currentColor`** | `scripts/check-conformance.mjs` checks `registry/mcpblocks/ui/icons.tsx` so icons inherit host text colors in light and dark themes. |
| **No sandbox-blocked APIs or ChatGPT globals** | ESLint and `scripts/check-conformance.mjs` ban `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `document.cookie`, and `window.openai` in `registry/mcpblocks/`. |
| **Skeletons, not spinners** | `skeleton` provides `RowsSkeleton`, `InlineCardSkeleton`, and `CarouselSkeleton`; no spinner component is shipped. |
| **Safe-area insets honored** | `applySafeAreaInsets()` writes `--mb-safe-{top,right,bottom,left}` from `hostContext.safeAreaInsets`; `Carousel` and fullscreen previews read them. |
| **Registry manifest & built artifacts stay in sync** | `scripts/check-conformance.mjs` validates `registry.json` paths, internal `registryDependencies`, and verifies every `public/r/*.json` matches source on disk. |

## Notes & Known Findings

- **WCAG AA contrast on `info` badges in light mode:** Claude's published `--color-text-info` (`#3266ad`) on `--color-background-info` (`#d6e4f6`) measures **4.47:1** in light mode (just under the 4.5:1 AA minimum for normal text). Text badges in `InlineCard` and `DocumentCard` therefore use `bg-host-info-bg` with `text-host-fg` and a subtle `border-host-info-border/40` (14.3:1 light / 10.0:1 dark). `StatusUpdate`'s info chip renders an icon only, where 4.47:1 clears WCAG's 3:1 non-text threshold.
- **Data visualization palette:** `LineChart` uses a four-color categorical `PALETTE` array because MCP Apps host tokens do not define multi-series chart colors. Consumers can override per-series `color` props.
